name: Zhenbian Shaonü
source:
Story: "Pillow Girl · Wutong"
The protagonist wished for a cute girl to sleep beside him.
To his surprise, right after he made that wish, a cute girl fell from the sky and landed on him.
She introduced herself as "Trainee Pillow Girl · Wutong," explaining that she needed his help to complete her training tasks to become a full-fledged Pillow Girl.
The protagonist agreed, only to realize he’d been far too naive…
And so, a hilarious and heartwarming little story began.

Story: "Pillow Girl · Mint"
The protagonist, Ai Xin, was a stone-cold loner who never went out of his way to help anyone—not even the class’s kind monitor, Luo Qin, could get through to him.
One day, by accident, Ai Xin downloaded an app called Pillow Girl.
While he was still trying to figure out what it was, a bubbly, cheerful girl appeared on his bed and started throwing a tantrum!
Ai Xin soon discovered that the only way to calm her down was to help others and do good deeds.
This left him conflicted…
And so, a bittersweet comedy of endless escapades with a Pillow Girl began.

Story: "Pillow Girl · Coco"
The protagonist, Zeng Cheng, was a workaholic who often struggled with insomnia.
One day, after returning to his long-neglected home, he found a beautiful girl lying on his bed!
She introduced herself as a Pillow Girl and immediately started playing the game console Zeng Cheng had bought ages ago.
Seeing this, Zeng Cheng felt a mix of exasperation and nostalgia for the days before he became a workaholic, when he used to play games.
A mix of laughter and melancholy in this tear-jerking yet humorous Pillow Girl story.

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/942930/_MOE_Hypnotist__share_dreams_with_you/]steam[/url]]
translation:
故事：《枕边姑娘·梧桐》主角希望有一个可爱的女孩睡在他身边。
谁知他刚刚许愿，一个可爱的女孩从天而降，落在了他的身上。
她介绍自己为“见习枕边姑娘·梧桐”，并解释说她需要他的帮助来完成训练任务，成为一名成熟的枕边姑娘。
主角答应了，却发现自己太天真了……
于是，一段搞笑又温馨的小故事开始了。

故事：《枕头女郎·薄荷》主角艾欣是一个冷酷的孤独者，从不特意帮助任何人，就连班长洛钦也无法搭理他。
有一天，一个偶然的机会，艾欣下载了一款名为“枕头女孩”的应用程序。
正当他还想弄清楚那是什么的时候，一个活泼开朗的女孩出现在他的床上，并且开始发脾气！
艾欣很快发现，让自己平静下来的唯一方法就是帮助别人、做好事。
这让他心里很矛盾……
于是，一场与枕头女郎的苦乐参半的喜剧开始了。

故事：《枕头女郎·可可》主人公曾诚是一个经常与失眠作斗争的工作狂。
有一天，他回到久违的家后，发现床上躺着一位美丽的女孩！
她介绍自己是“枕头姑娘”，然后就开始玩曾诚多年前买的游戏机。
看到这一幕，曾诚心里既懊恼又怀念自己成为工作狂之前打游戏的日子。
这个催人泪下又幽默的《枕边女孩》故事中夹杂着欢笑和忧郁。

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/942930/_MOE_Hypnotist__share_dreams_with_you/]steam[/url]]
